findings.quoted_text: If any Product Collateral IP (or any aspect thereof) are not designed and/or created by Calm, such Product Collateral IP (or aspect thereof) shall be deemed "works made for hire" for Calm within the meaning of the U.S. Copyright Law and/or other applicable comparable laws or, if they do not so qualify, all ownership rights thereto shall be, and are hereby, assigned to Calm.

If any Product Collateral IP (or any aspect thereof) are not designed and/or created by Calm, such Product Collateral IP (or aspect thereof) shall be deemed "works made for hire" for Calm within the meaning of the U.S. Copyright Law and/or other applicable comparable laws or, if they do not so qualify, all ownership rights thereto shall be, and are hereby, assigned to Calm.
findings.explanation: Intellectual property rights transfer to the client upon creation or delivery rather than upon full payment, which means you could lose your rights before getting paid.
findings.suggested_change: Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable work, all intellectual property rights in the Product Collateral IP shall be assigned to the Client.

content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hello,

Thank you for sharing the agreement. I am looking forward to working together, but I would like to propose a few small adjustments before signing.

- Regarding the clause stating that 'If any Product Collateral IP (or any aspect thereof) are not designed and/or created by Calm...', the intellectual property rights transfer to the client upon creation or delivery rather than upon full payment, which means you could lose your rights before getting paid. I suggest updating this so that 'Upon receipt of full payment for the applicable work, all intellectual property rights in the Product Collateral IP shall be assigned to the Client.'

Best regards,
